title: Wallis/Stirling Asymptotics of the Diagonal Beta Value
description: Establishes the asymptotic decay of the diagonal Euler Beta value from the parent closed form B(n+1,n+1) = 1/((2n+1)·C(2n,n)). Deriving the central binomial estimate C(2n,n) ~ 4ⁿ/√(πn) from Mathlib’s factorial_isEquivalent_stirling (centralBinom_isEquivalent), it gives B(n+1,n+1) ~ √(πn)/((2n+1)·4ⁿ) (betaDiag_isEquivalent) — the Wallis-rate mass collapse of the symmetric Beta density — neither of which Mathlib states. 0 axioms, 0 sorries.
